chapter_title: Bibha Chowdhuri: The Beam of Light that Lit the Path for Women in Indian Science
main_summary: A profile of Dr. Bibha Chowdhuri (1913–1991), a pioneering Indian nuclear physicist. She researched cosmic rays and subatomic particle (pi-meson) tracks at the Bose Institute in Kolkata and University of Manchester under Nobel Laureate Patrick Blackett. Nominated for a Nobel Prize by Erwin Schrödinger and appointed TIFR's first female faculty member by Homi Bhabha, her legacy was permanently honored in 2019 when the IAU named a star 'Bibha'.
key_themes: Women in STEM and overcoming historical gender barriers
Pioneering research in cosmic rays and nuclear physics
literary_devices_and_poetic_techniques: Symbolic Title Metaphor ('Beam of Light' = Physicist lighting path for future women)
